about: Example of the recall eval format used by scripts/eval_recall.py. Each question is phrased the way you would really ask it (not copied from the memory text) and lists the memory ids that answer it; any one counts as a hit. The real set refers to private memories and is not published. Write your own against your live memories and add a question whenever recall misses something it should have found.

questions.q: which port does the expense tracker backend run on?
